name: 35-wave lightweight skeleton
allowed: Catalog exact nodes and existing bindings; derive only shallow discovery tokens; expose gaps.
forbidden: Deep continuity rulings, source-structure adjudication, family concepts, respondent joins.
exit_gate: 35 active waves cataloged; exact identities preserved; all existing response bindings accounted for; gaps explicit

name: source-family deep pass
allowed: Review all active waves of one survey together; source text, routing, universe, structures, exact aliases.
forbidden: Cross-source authority before both sides are reviewed; family authoring.
exit_gate: Every active wave of one source deeply reviewed

name: within-source continuity closure
allowed: Issue positive and negative longitudinal edges and reconcile every likely lineage.

name: global candidate refresh
allowed: Generate provisional cross-source edges against reviewed sources and shallow unreviewed skeleton.
exit_gate: Cross-source suggestions refreshed with one-sided status preserved

name: all-survey reconciliation
allowed: Resolve portability tiers after all nine sources are deeply reviewed.
forbidden: Force every node into a universal concept.
exit_gate: All two-sided portability candidates disposed or blocked

name: P2 closure
allowed: Coverage, identity, determinism, provenance and unresolved-gap audit.
forbidden: Begin candidate collision graph before closure.
exit_gate: Coverage and determinism close with zero unexplained remainder
